## Process & timeline by property type


#### HDB resale

1. **Seller: Intent to Sell** — valid 12 months, **7-day wait before OTP**.
2. **Buyer: HFE letter** — mandatory before OTP granted *or* exercised. ~21 working days. **Valid 9 months.**
3. **OTP** — option fee $1–$1,000. **21 calendar days** to exercise.
4. **Request for Value** — next working day after option date, **$120** non-refundable.
5. **Exercise** — option + exercise fee **capped at $5,000**, cash only.
6. **Joint resale application** within 7 days.
7. **HDB processing ~8 weeks** → completion, keys.

**12–16 weeks from OTP; 3–4 months end-to-end. COV is cash only.**

**Grants (first-timers, stackable):** EHG up to **$120,000** families / **$60,000** singles; CPF Housing Grant up to **$80,000** (2–4rm) / **$50,000** (5rm+); PHG up to **$30,000**.

#### Private resale (condo / landed)

1% option fee → OTP (typically 14 days, 14–21 negotiable) → exercise with further 4% → **BSD/ABSD within 14 days of exercise** → completion **8–12 weeks**.

**Landed additions:** PRs/foreigners need **LDAU approval** under the Residential Property Act (~30 working days). Plan 3–6 months. Bank valuation gap is the landed equivalent of COV — get an indicative valuation *before* exercising.

#### EC (new, from developer)

- Income ceiling **$16,000/month** (new EC from developer only; not resale EC).
- At least one SC; 21 yrs (35 under Joint Singles); eligible family nucleus.
- **No private residential property owned or disposed of in the past 30 months.**
- **MSR 30% applies.** Bank financing only.
- **No ABSD upfront** for HDB upgraders, but the flat must be sold **within 6 months of TOP**.
- Resale levy may apply.

**Existing rules (everything currently launched or in the pipeline):** 5-yr MOP from TOP; privatisation at 10 yrs; DPS may be available.

**New rules — EC GLS sites with tender closing on/after 8 May 2026:** MOP **5 → 10 years** · privatisation **10 → 15 years** · **DPS removed** · first-timer quota **70% → 90%** · priority window **1 month → 2 years**. Won't affect a completed EC until roughly 2029+.

#### New launch — Progressive Payment Scheme

| Milestone | % |
|---|---|
| Booking / OTP | 5% — **cash only** |
| S&P exercise (within 8 weeks) | 15% — cash and/or CPF |
| Foundation | 10% — loan drawdown begins |
| Reinforced concrete framework | 10% |
| Partition walls | 5% |
| Roofing / ceiling | 5% |
| Door & window frames, wiring, plumbing | 5% |
| Car parks, roads, drains | 5% |
| **TOP** | **25%** |
| **CSC / legal completion** | **15%** |

BSD/ABSD within 14 days of S&P. Typical span 3–4 years. **Interest accrues only on the drawn portion.**

## BUYER — total cost of acquisition


| Cost | HDB resale | Private resale | New launch |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Buyer's Stamp Duty** | Yes — full scale | Yes | Yes |
| **ABSD** | If applicable | If applicable | If applicable |
| **Mortgage stamp duty** | **0.4% of loan, cap $500** | Same | Same |
| Option + exercise fee | ≤$5,000 total, **cash** | 1% + 4% = 5% | 5% booking (**cash**) + 15% |
| Downpayment balance | To 25% (cash/CPF) | To 25% (cash/CPF) | Progressive |
| **Minimum cash** | 5% | 5% | **5% at booking, cash only** |
| **COV / valuation gap** | **Cash only** | Cash only | N/A |
| Valuation fee | **$120** Request for Value | ~$300–500 bank valuation | Usually N/A |
| Legal / conveyancing | HDB solicitors (tiered, min ~$21.80) or private lawyer **$1,300–$3,000** | **$2,500–$3,500** | $2,500–$3,500 |
| Registration / caveat fees | Buyer's caveat ~$64.45; lease-in-escrow ~$38.30 | Caveat + title fees | Caveat + title fees |
| HDB resale application admin fee | $40 (1–2rm) / **$80** (3rm+) per party | N/A | N/A |
| Agent commission | Negotiable, agreed in writing | Negotiable, agreed in writing | Negotiable, agreed in writing |
| Mortgage insurance | HPS (CPF) or MRTA | MRTA | MRTA |
| Fire / home insurance | Mandatory for HDB | Recommended | Recommended |
| Renovation & furnishing | $30k–$80k+ | $50k–$150k+ | $50k–$150k+ (bare handover) |
| **Recurring** | Property tax, conservancy charges, loan | Property tax, **MCST $300–$800/mth**, loan | Same, from TOP |
